About
School of Mathematical Sciences
About
Driving mathematical discovery and real-world impact
The School of Mathematical Sciences explores the language of the universe, from abstract theory to real-world applications. Renowned for excellence in research and education, our staff have a long history of achievement. Our students learn from world-class mathematicians and data scientists, gaining skills to model, analyse and solve complex problems across health, defence, technology, finance and sustainability. Through hands-on learning in workshops, industry projects, internships, mentoring and honours and postgraduate pathways, our graduates are equipped to shape solutions in a data-driven world.
Discover School of Mathematical Sciences
Explore our study areas
Study pure and applied mathematics, statistics or data science. Gain expertise in analysis, modelling and problem-solving, with opportunities for internships, honours and research projects.
Explore our study areas
Discover our research
Our research spans pure and applied mathematics, statistics, optimisation and data science. We collaborate with industry and government to deliver insights that transform technology, health, defence, finance and society.
Research areas
Explore the School of Mathematical Sciences
About School of Mathematical Sciences
We unite theory and application to advance discovery, innovation and industry impact through mathematics, statistics and data science.
About us
Research capabilities
Our researchers lead internationally recognised work in pure mathematics, mathematical modelling, optimisation, statistics, and data science, supported by Australian Research Council fellowships and within the Adelaide Data Science Centre.
Discover our research
Study areas
Our programs build strong analytical and problem-solving skills across pure and applied mathematics, statistics and data science, preparing graduates for careers in science, industry, government and beyond.
View study areas
Our people
Our staff include internationally recognised mathematicians and data scientists, preparing students with the confidence and creativity to thrive in a data-driven future.
Get to know the team
Engage with us
We partner with industry, government and research organisations to translate mathematics into solutions for society. Engagement includes internships, consultancy, professional training and collaborative research projects.
